يستعرون (form VIII)
# يَسْتَعِرُونَ (yastaʕirūna) /jas.ta.ʕi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# يُسْتَعَرُونَ (yustaʕarūna) /jus.ta.ʕa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
